subject: p-fc
title: P.FC.------PHY.U.P.
description: Chart 3 of 3 on book p. 128 (AE(PD)-16). P-FC (particular focus) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) is the partner. From the subject: AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From AF-DY: LANG (language). From RT-ALGN: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and INTR (interpretation). From VT-DY: INFO-DS (information dissemination). From INTR: V-SY (value system) and AF-NT (affinity nature). From AF-NT: IST-F (isolated focus).
